data.desc: Zumiez is a leading specialty retailer of apparel, footwear, accessories and hardgoods for young men and women who want to express their individuality through the fashion, music, art and culture of action sports, streetwear, and other unique lifestyles. As of October 31, 2026, we operated 715 stores, including 562 in the United States, 45 in Canada, 81 in Europe and 27 in Australia. We operate under the names Zumiez, Blue Tomato and Fast Times.
